restatement: Add prompt-shaped whitespace handling and literal braces to the core template language. With standaloneLines on, lines that hold only flow-control block tags (IF/ELSEIF/ELSE/END_IF, CASE family, FOR/END_FOR, comments, and RAW/END_RAW) vanish along with their line break. LIST/TABLE-family tags keep their old spacing. Minus markers trim adjacent whitespace on every block tag and comment, whether the option is on or off. RAW/END_RAW emit literal content and report an unclosed RAW as a located syntax error. A single backslash before the opening brace pair escapes it. spec() documents RAW and the option. render defaults the option to true and resolveTemplate defaults it to false, so the existing suite and resolveTemplate's default output stay unchanged. No new runtime dependency.

findings.title: An odd run of backslashes before the brace pair does not escape it

serves.scenario: With three backslashes before {{x}}, the last backslash sits directly before the pair, yet the lexer reads the leading pair as 'one literal backslash and an active tag'. render then fails with 'Unknown template tag: {{x}}' instead of printing literal braces. With three backslashes before {{IF x}}y{{END_IF}}, the output is two backslashes followed by y. The contract only defines the one- and two-backslash cases, so this is noted for the lead, not a fix request.

findings.rubric: each criterion is met by the diff and its test
findings.reproduction: In JS: render(String.fromCharCode(92).repeat(3) + '{{x}}', {}) gives ok=false, 'Unknown template tag: {{x}}'; render(String.fromCharCode(92).repeat(3) + '{{IF x}}y{{END_IF}}', {x:true}) gives two backslashes and 'y'.
